title: 第十三章 相逢
content_zh:
帷帽少女没有理睬走向自己的锦衣少年，视线越过少年肩头，望向那个亦步亦趋的高大老人，她神色郁郁道：“方才你一言不合就要杀人，虽然你有你的理由，但是我觉得这样不对。”
锦衣少年在冷峻少女七八步距离外，停下身形，眼神真诚道：“我叫高稹，是大隋弋阳郡人氏。吴爷爷若有得罪之处，我愿意向姑娘道歉和补偿。”
高大老人站在锦衣少年身后，心情复杂。所谓的大隋弋阳郡高氏子弟，其实不过是个含蓄说法罢了。大隋国祚一千二百年，坐龙椅的人都姓高，太祖皇帝便是龙兴于弋阳郡。
少女对此无动于衷，抬起双手系紧绷带，对老人说道：“若是在外边，面对一位极有可能已经‘御风远游’的武道大宗师，我绝非对手。但是此时此刻，我只要假借飞剑，你必死无疑。”
高大老人冷笑道：“只要那名刺客事先知晓你的杀手锏，以他那副小宗师巅峰的体魄，只要护住要害，任你刺穿十剑又如何？他尚且如此，更何况我比他高出两个境界，其中一道门槛还被视为武道天堑。小姑娘，我不知道你哪来的底气，才说得出来‘必死无疑’四个字。”
少女皱了皱眉头，一只手悄然扶住刀柄，“我是很怕麻烦的人，更讨厌跟人吵架，不然我们出手试试看真假？谁赢了谁有道理，如何？”
极少有机会被人威胁的老人有些恼火。如果不是身处于这个神憎鬼厌的诡谲地方，就少女这般修为的修士，任她再天赋异禀，老人一只手也能碾压虐杀十个。退一步说，如果不是重任在身，需要照顾被大隋举国寄予厚望的少年殿下，老人哪怕拼着被此处自行循环的大道镇压重伤，也要好好教训一下不知天高地厚的少女，初生牛犊不怕虎，勇气可嘉，仅此而已，可不意味着猛虎就不会把牛犊吃得一干二净。
自称高稹的锦衣少年赶紧打圆场道：“如果姑娘一定要追究，我愿意拿出此物作为弥补。”
高稹低头以表诚意，只求姑娘不要追究先前吴爷爷的无心冒犯，他毕竟是出于忠义，并无害人之心。”
眉发皆白的高大老宦官顿时悚然，单膝下跪，惶恐不安道：“殿下不可！老奴何等腌臜，此方玉玺却是殿下机缘所在，是世间罕有的纯粹宝物，甚至能够承载民间香火，两者如何能够相提并论，殿下这是要活活逼死老奴啊！”
出身天潢贵胄的高姓少年脸色僵硬。
少女好似有些不耐烦，讥讽笑道：“偏居一隅的井底之蛙，倒是人人都喜欢敝帚自珍。将那方玉玺收回去吧，我一直很喜欢一句话，叫君子不夺人所好。”
少女行事干脆利落，转身就走。
锦衣少年如释重负，“起来吧，吴爷爷，跪着多不像话。我大隋十二位大貂寺，素来只跪帝王，这要是被六科言官或是礼部的人瞧见，拿出来说事，咱们俩都要倒霉。行了，这趟小镇之行，我承蒙祖宗庇护，圆满完成，我们就不要横生枝节了，速速离开此地，而且在外头跟自己人接应后，也不可掉以轻心，要知道大骊王朝内的六大柱国，其中袁、曹两家虽是对立阵营，但是很不凑巧，这两根大骊砥柱，与我们大隋高氏有不共戴天之仇，一旦吴爷爷你在此有了意外，战力受损，我很难安然无恙地返回大隋。”
老人点点头，缓缓起身，“老奴知晓事情的轻重，缓急。”
当老人说到“急”这个字眼的时候，帷帽少女已经走出去二十余步。
锦衣少年身边拂过一阵清风，鬓角发丝和锦衣袍袖都被吹得飘荡起来。
原来身边这位在大隋权柄煊赫的老人，根本就没有放过少女的心思，此时已经一冲而去，前三步重重踩踏在小巷地面上，声响沉闷，直透地面底下一丈有余，第四步的时候，老人已经高高跃起，一拳砸向少女后背心。
帷帽少女腰肢猛然拧转，以左脚脚尖为支撑点，右手拔刀出鞘，小巷当中出现一抹比阳光更耀眼的雪白光辉。
高大老人以压顶之势扑杀而至，一拳直直砸在刀锋上，手背竟然只被锋芒气盛的刃口割出一条血痕，老宦官双脚轰然落地后，继续前冲，推得持刀少女一直向后倒退，老人随即轻描淡写伸出一掌，看似缓慢从容，实则闪电一般推在了少女额头，老人刚要加重力道，一掌碎裂这颗隐藏在帷帽下的脑袋，连忙脚步挪动，身形横移一尺，扑哧一声，低头一看，有利器从后背穿透自己右边胸口，是剑尖。

老人脸色不变，双指并拢夹住剑尖，向后一推。
将那柄循着少女心意来此的凌厉飞剑，硬生生推出自己的胸口。
因为受到飞剑的阻滞，老宦官非但没能一掌拍碎少女头颅，那个身体倒飞出去摔在小巷中的少女，借此喘息机会，起身后身形矫健如狸猫，很快从一条小巷岔道消失。
少年脸色阴沉得可怕，双拳紧握，气势勃发，满脸怒容道：“御马监掌印太监，吴钺吴貂寺！你为何不肯听从我的暗示，非要如此偏执行事，当真以为这座小镇就数你吴貂寺最天下无敌？明明是我们做错在先，事后她也未曾咄咄逼人，已经愿意息事宁人，为何你还要如此毒辣，简直就是欺人太甚！”
老宦官从少女逃离小巷的方向，收回视线，转身走回，腰杆挺直，愈发显得气势巍峨。老人一步一步缓缓走回，像是重重踩在心坎上。
少年感受到那股令人窒息的威势，被一个奴才压迫，更是满腔怒火，瞪大双眼，咬牙切齿道：“御马监吴貂寺，你这是死罪！”
老宦官淡然道：“殿下，死罪活罪，需要陛下亲自定夺。在咱家看来，殿下的安危，是山岳之重，是摆在最首要的位置，而小镇少女的存在本身，在咱家看来，已经成为燃眉之急，所以真正想要万事大吉，只有对她痛下杀手，她死了，咱家才能安心。”
看到少年眼眸中几乎压抑不住的熊熊怒火，老宦官叹了口气，轻声道：“在皇宫大内任职六十余年，咱家见过太多太多的勾心斗角，血腥的，不沾血的，不计其数，对于人心，咱家实在是没有丝毫信心了。仅是护驾途中的刺杀事件，大大小小，咱家就亲手解决不下三十余起。殿下，那些刺客杀手的阴险狡诈，绝对出乎想象，尤其是一些丧心病狂的死士，根本不可理喻，就拿刚才的蒙面杀手和帷帽少女来说……”
锦衣少年伸出手指，指向脸色冷漠的老宦官，愤怒指责道：“闭嘴！你这个老阉人！我不想听你的胡说八道！我只确定你毁了我的精心拉拢，就是个瞎子，也知道那个能够驾驭飞剑的少女，是如何天赋异禀、惊才绝艳！哪怕放于山上的修行之人当中，她也是最拔尖的天才！这样的角色，莫说是大隋或是大骊，便是整个东宝瓶洲，她也是凤毛麟角的存在！我只需要培养她十年，最多二十年，她就能够成为我身后影子里，最厉害的刺客！任你是陆地神仙，是武道大宗师，算得了什么？！结果呢？我是高稹，是大隋王朝的未来太子！是你这个吴老阉人的主子！”
很奇怪，饱经沧桑的年迈宦官，非但没有被一口一个“老阉人”惹恼，反而眼神愈发欣慰，等到少年发泄完毕，终于停下骂街行为，老人看着气喘吁吁的少年，微笑道：“殿下，虽然你可能因为有些事情，未曾亲身经历过，所以不知世道诡谲和人心险恶，但是殿下有件事做得很好，很有陛下当年的风采。”
气氛尴尬。
高稹冷静之后，应该是意识到自己大错特错了，在尚未被钦定成为太子之前，就对一位御马监掌印太监、兼大隋皇宫三位看门人之一的老人，如此不敬，而且关键此人还深得父皇母后两人的信赖，于是皇子高稹张了张嘴巴，却看到那个被自己骂做老阉的权势宦官，笑道：“殿下，，下人也未必领情。哪怕心怀愧疚，也应该深深埋在心底，需知被誉为人间真龙的皇帝君王，是口含天宪的九五之尊……”
高稹道：“吴爷爷，以我如今的身份，说这个太早了。”
老宦官突然身体紧绷，如临大敌，一把将锦衣少年拉到自己身后，老人望向蒙面杀手的尸体那边。
有个身材修长的中年儒士，突兀出现小巷尽头处，缓缓走入，来到杀手尸体附近，蹲下后，摘下面巾，只看到一张奇怪的脸庞，无眉毛，被削鼻，脸上刻字。
此人生前曾经是刑徒，这一点毋庸置疑。
儒士默然，果然是早有预谋，恐怕这场谋划，要从那座文庙开始算起。
高稹眼神炽热，从老宦官身后走出来，弯腰作揖，不管如何先行礼再说，然后才抬头恭敬问道：“敢问可是山崖书院的齐先生？”
儒士站起身，对高稹说道：“若非你率先占据了一份大机缘，你们两人今日无法如此轻松离开。”
外来人氏在小镇上相互厮杀，按照最早四位圣人订立的规矩，惩罚并不重，但也不能算轻，相较于滥杀小镇凡夫俗子必然会被驱逐，外人之间的争斗，就存在一个明显的“漏洞”，让人可以亡羊补牢，高稹在内三拨人，之所以都携带一位“扈从”，也正是因此做了最坏的准备，以便在关键时刻推出来做替罪羊，要不然仅仅是一个名额，就要耗费大隋高氏皇帝内库的一半积蓄，好歹是一位泱泱上国、皇帝陛下的私房钱，整整一半家底子，金额之大，可想而知，所以谁肯无缘无故当这么个冤大头？

其实说的通俗一点，就是花钱消灾罢了。
只不过在这里的开销，用搬空一座金山银山来形容也不为过，世俗市井所谓的一掷千金，对比起来简直就是儿戏。
被下了逐客令的高稹，继续自顾自说道：“齐先生，以后有机会的话，能否去我大隋书院讲学？我大隋愿意专门为先生，将‘国师’虚位以待！”
老宦官想了想，还是没有阻止少年的僭越言论。
如果真的能够说服这位读书人，日后为大隋高氏出谋划策，大隋皇帝肯定龙颜大悦。
儒士笑了笑，对此不曾答话。
老宦官对待萍水相逢的帷帽少女，杀伐果决，心狠手辣，此时面对这位坐镇此处的定海神针，山崖书院的齐先生，就呈现出另一种极端姿态，低头抱拳道：“齐先生，多有叨扰，还望海涵。方才对一个晚辈出手，实在是无奈之举，希望先生体谅咱家作为高家奴仆的苦心。”
齐静春一挥袖，“速速离去。”
高稹和老宦官只得告辞离去，刚好走了一条帷帽少女撤退的路线。
少年低声问道：“她死了？”
老宦官摇头道：“肯定命不久矣。飞剑无非是让她多活片刻，于事无补。”
少年犹豫了一下，好奇问道：“吴爷爷是什么时候看出她驾驭飞剑，其实远远没有表面看上去那么轻松惬意？”
老人说道：“过犹不及，她的早慧漏了马脚。”
少年讶异不解。
老宦官带着少年拐出原先小巷，轻声道：“咱家问殿下一个问题，殿下见多了世间富贵豪奢的珍奇物件，还会对小镇寻常瓷器感兴趣吗？”
少年拍了拍腰间口袋，笑道：“当然不会，只有这方玉玺，或者跟它差不多水准的玩意儿，才能让我感到欣喜。”
老宦官点头道：“正是此理。那个少女在御剑杀人的时候，心如止水，极其镇定从容，就像……常人的吃喝拉撒。而且事后察觉到我的真实武道修为后，便果断放弃争斗的念头，尤其是害怕我反过来看穿她的色厉内荏，故意主动挑衅我们，她的真实意图，是好给双方各自找一个台阶下，是怕咱家心存杀心，宁肯错杀也不愿错放，对她斩草除根，所以她必须要破局，当然，事实证明她做得并不好。不过说到底，小小年纪，有此心思，已经很不简单。但越是如此，一旦放虎归山，任其茁壮成长，将来以后对殿下的威胁就是越大。”
老人感慨道：“少年少女，正值意气风发，若是热血杀人，或是慷慨赴死，其实咱家都不奇怪，但是缓缓思量之后的从容赴死，或是生不起半点心湖涟漪的杀人，就很反常。甚至可以说，这只能被阅历磨砺出来的性情，跟一个人的天赋高低，资质好坏，都没有太大关系。无论修士还是武夫，许多天才早夭，就在于性情短板太过明显，一遇坎坷就容易坏事。”
高稹哀叹道：“不管怎么说，都可惜了。”
老宦官半真半假玩笑道：“殿下，如果这样一个人物的生死，就要叹气一次，那么等到殿下以后真正站在山顶，应该会很忙的。”

少年笑道：“我不信。”
老宦官突然说道：“不知是否错觉，咱家感觉到那位齐先生，一身通天修为，好像出了不小的问题。”
这位大隋皇子满脸无所谓道：“反正原本只要能够拿到这方‘龙门’玺，就算大功告成，哪里想到这方价值连城的宝玺，竟然‘沦为’了大买卖的小添头，所以是该咱们见好就收了。一说起那条金色鲤鱼，我就忍不住想到那个草鞋少年……”
老宦官笑道：“殿下是想着以后找个机会，感谢一下这位少年？”
少年摇头道：“哪里啊，我是心疼那一袋子铜钱呢。”
老人哑然失笑。
以后隋朝说不定会有一位勤俭皇帝？
————
一条南北向的僻静小巷，唯有车轱辘声。
有个头顶莲花冠的年轻道士，今天早早不做生意了，正在推车前行，想着回到住处后，收拾收拾，赶紧打道回府，这个烂摊子，谁掺和谁倒灶。
有个身材苗条的黑衣人，突然从东西向的小巷岔口处，踉踉跄跄走出来，最后背靠着墙壁，缓缓移动，一手越过帷帽浅露薄纱，使劲捂住嘴巴，一手指向年轻道人。
年轻道人赶紧低头，默念道：“看不到我……看不到我……太上老君急急如律令……就算了吧，还是佛祖保佑，菩萨显灵……”
一个道士事到临头，不求三清老祖，反而去求佛拜菩萨，实在是有些不像话。
果然，佛祖菩萨好像是不乐意搭理别教门下的徒子徒孙，那帷帽少女不知哪里冒出的最后一点气力，摇摇晃晃冲向道人，扑通一声重重摔倒，但是最后一只手死死攥住了道人的脚踝。
年轻道人双手捧住脑袋，一脸崩溃的凄惨模样，好像是在仰头问天：“这么大一个因果砸过来，不等于让贫道在额头刻上‘一心求死’四个字吗？贫道这些年云游四方，风餐露宿，跋山涉水，经常走在街上被狗咬……很辛苦的好不好！干你娘的大隋高氏，还有姓吴的老狗，你们给贫道等着，这笔账没有五百年，根本算不清楚……贫道的道行修为这么浅，真的挑不起什么重担子啊……”
已经语无伦次的年轻道人低下头，只差没有泪流满面了，“小姑娘，你发发慈悲心，放过贫道好不好，回头贫道就帮你找一处山清水秀的地方，风水极好，肯定能够福泽子嗣……哦不对，姑娘还是黄花大闺女，那就……”
少女已经彻底晕死过去。
年轻道人眼见四下无人，蹲下身就要悄悄掰开少女的五指。
嗖一下。
飞剑凌空悬停，剑尖距离年轻道人的眉心，不过三寸。

年轻道人不露声色地松开手，满脸怜悯，大义凛然道：“人非草木，岂能没有恻隐之心？贫道这一生风光霁月，岂是那种见死不救之人？！”
年轻道人盘膝而坐，整张英俊的脸庞都快要皱成一团，“接下来送往何处，也是麻烦啊。”
一直距离道人眉心三寸的那把飞剑，迅猛前移一寸。
道人耐心解释道：“想要让你主人活下来，贫道还需要一个帮手，对了，你去老槐树那边戳一枚槐叶过来，贫道先替她吊住这一口元气，你家主人有些特殊，贫道不想为了救人而胡乱救人，到时候不小心耽误了她的修行前程，这一桩新因果……又他娘的让贫道想死了一了百了啊……”
飞剑好似在犹豫，剑尖微微颤抖。
道人没好气道：“早去一分，你家主人，就能从鬼门关早走回来一步。去晚了，大家一起完蛋！”
飞剑眨眼间便消失不见。
道人低声气愤道：“郎有情妾有意，才成良人美眷，你齐静春齐大先生倒好，乱点鸳鸯谱，拉屎也不擦屁股！”
年轻道人一手托腮帮，一手掐指算卦，“容贫道来算算，将你送到小镇哪户人家，你既能活下来，对方也不至于家破人亡。先从卢家……卢家不行，跟赵家差不多，已经机缘在身，那就宋家？”
这边小巷里的道人话音未落。
福禄街上的宋家门庭，张贴在大小门扉上的所有门神，瞬间失去神采，黯淡无光，还有凡人肉眼不可见的缕缕青烟升起。
庭院深深处，有一位赤脚老人沧桑老人推门而出，站在院子里跳脚怒骂道：“是哪个王八蛋在谋害我宋氏基业？！站出来一战！”
年轻道人咳嗽一声，自言自语：“福禄街的刘家，瞧着香火鼎盛，像是能扛事的主儿，试试看？”
刘家那块传承千年的家族堂匾额，砰然碎裂，出现一条条触目惊心的裂缝。
有老妪嗓音浑厚，以龙头拐杖重重敲击地面，“何方神圣，能否出来一见？！”
年轻道人假装什么都没有发生，“那就桃叶巷的魏家？一看你们家就是积善积德的，肯定承受得起这份因果。”
很快就有个老人以秘术传音，向学塾那边怒吼道：“齐静春！你不管管？！你要是管不了，或是不敢管，就赶紧滚蛋，把位置让给阮邛！让他来收拾这个鬼鬼祟祟的家伙！还是说这一切，就是你齐静春本人在发泄私怨？”
有个男人在小镇廊桥以南的小溪畔，正在领着人挖井，站直身后，他向北方嘴唇微动。
仿佛一声声春雷，在福禄街和桃叶巷上空滚滚响动，“够了！不许对齐先生不敬，而且我阮某人也绝不会在春分之前，涉足小镇事务！”
一时间，天地寂寥，万籁寂静。

而那个小巷推车旁边坐着的罪魁祸首，正在抓起黑衣少女的一只手，然后将那片飞剑带来的翠绿槐叶，丢在她鲜血模糊的手心上。
槐叶触及少女手心伤口后，如冰雪消融，转瞬消散。
年轻道人感慨道：“每每见到此情此景，都要为这份天地造化之功，感到……”
酝酿了半天，道人也没能想出自己满意的言语。
年轻道人最后低头，看着微微有些气色流溢的少女，有些犯难，“既然你牵扯到的气数，比贫道想象还要大，那就只能逆其道而行之了。小镇之上，六百户人家，盘根交错，世世代代浸染此方秘境的气息，你要说让贫道找个有气数萦绕的家伙，轻而易举，可是找个穷光蛋，比登天还难啊。这就像是在朝会大殿上，找个当大官的，容易，找个乞丐，你让贫道怎么找？”
年轻道人咦了一声。
还真找到这么一个可怜虫。
他没有丝毫惊喜，反而悚然，闭上眼睛，扪心自问。
年轻道人叹了口气，“不管怎么样，先看你会如何选择，贫道决不强求，你若是不愿，贫道便自己担起这份因果好了。”
最后他学僧人双手合十，“佛祖保佑，菩萨显灵，一定要让贫道渡过此劫啊。”
————
泥瓶巷中。
年轻道人弯腰推着一辆双轮车，来到一处院门外停下，敲门后，问道：“陈平安在吗？”
推车上，角落缝隙里，放着一把雪白鞘的长剑，鞘内飞剑，病恹恹的，像是在嫌弃年轻道人找了这么个破落户。

The girl in the curtain hat ignored the young man in brocade clothes who was walking toward her. She looked over the young man's shoulder and looked at the tall old man who was following suit. She said with a gloomy expression, "Just now you wanted to kill someone because of your disagreement. Although you have your reasons, I don't think it's right."
The boy in brocade clothes stopped seven or eight steps away from the stern girl, and said with sincerity in his eyes: "My name is Gao Zhen, and I am from Yiyang County in the Sui Dynasty. If Grandpa Wu has offended me in any way, I am willing to apologize and make amends to the girl."
The tall old man stood behind the young man in brocade clothes with mixed emotions. The so-called descendants of the Gao family in Yiyang County of the Great Sui Dynasty are actually just an implicit statement. During the 1,200th year of the reign of Emperor Zuo of the Sui Dynasty, the people who sat on the Dragon Throne all had the surname Gao. Emperor Taizu was the Dragon Xing in Yiyang County.
The girl was indifferent to this, raised her hands to tie the bandage tightly, and said to the old man: "If I were to face a martial arts master outside who was very likely to have traveled far away from home, I would be no match. But at this moment, if I just use the flying sword under the guise, you will definitely die."
The tall old man sneered: "As long as that assassin knows your trump card in advance, with his peak body of a young master, what if he can protect his vital points and let you pierce ten swords? He is like this, not to mention that I am two realms higher than him, and one of the thresholds is considered a natural chasm in martial arts. Little girl, I don't know where you got the confidence to say the words 'Death is certain'."
The girl frowned and quietly held the handle of the knife with one hand, "I'm a person who is very afraid of trouble, and I hate quarrels with others. How about we give it a try and see what's true? Who wins and who makes sense? How about that?"
The old man, who rarely had the chance to be threatened, was a little annoyed. If we weren't in this weird place where gods and ghosts hated us, the old man could crush and kill ten of the monks with one hand, no matter how talented she was. To take a step back, if it were not for the heavy responsibility and the need to take care of His Highness, a young man who had high hopes from the whole country of the Sui Dynasty, even if the old man was seriously injured by the self-circulating avenue here, he would still have to teach the young girl who does not know the heights of the world a lesson. A newborn calf is not afraid of tigers, and its courage is commendable. That is all, but it does not mean that the tiger will not eat the calf completely.
The young man in Jinyi, who called himself Gao Zhen, quickly smoothed things over and said, "If the girl must pursue the case, I am willing to take out this thing as compensation."
Gao Zhen lowered his head to show his sincerity, and only asked the girl not to pursue Grandpa Wu's unintentional offense before. After all, he was out of loyalty and had no intention of harming anyone. "
The tall old eunuch with white eyebrows suddenly became horrified, knelt down on one knee, and said in fear: "No, Your Highness! How dirty the old slave is, but this square jade seal is your highness' chance. It is a rare pure treasure in the world, and can even carry folk incense. How can the two be compared? Your highness is going to force the old slave to death! "
The young man surnamed Gao, who was born in a noble family in Tianhuang, had a stiff face.
The girl seemed a little impatient, and said with a sarcastic smile: "I am a frog in a well, but everyone likes to keep their brooms to themselves. Take that square jade seal back. I have always liked a saying that says a gentleman should not take what others like. "
The girl acted crisply and neatly, turned around and left.
The young man in brocade clothes was relieved and said, "Get up, Grandpa Wu, it's shameful to kneel down. I, the twelve Great Diao Temples of the Sui Dynasty, have always only knelt down to the emperor. If this is seen by the Liu Ke Yan Guan or the people from the Ministry of Rites, and they are brought up to argue, we will both be in trouble. Okay, this trip to the small town has been successfully completed thanks to the protection of my ancestors. Let’s not create any complications and leave this place quickly. Moreover, after meeting with our own people outside, we must not take it lightly. We must know the six pillar countries in the Great Li Dynasty. Among them, Yuan and Cao are in opposing camps, but unfortunately, these two pillars have a sworn hatred with our Gao family in the Sui Dynasty. Once you, Grandpa Wu, have an accident here and your combat power is damaged, it will be difficult for me to return to the Sui Dynasty unharmed. "
The old man nodded and stood up slowly, "Old slave knowsThe importance and urgency of things. "
When the old man said the word "urgent", the girl in the curtain hat had already walked out more than twenty steps.
A breeze blew past the young man in brocade clothes, causing the hair on his temples and the sleeves of his brocade robe to flutter.
It turned out that the old man next to him, who was very powerful in the Sui Dynasty, had no intention of letting go of the girl. At this time, he rushed away. The first three steps were heavily stepped on the ground of the alley. The sound was dull and penetrated more than a foot into the ground. On the fourth step, the old man had already jumped high and punched the girl's back vest.
The girl in the curtain hat suddenly twisted her waist, using the toes of her left foot as a support point, she drew the sword out of its sheath with her right hand, and a snow-white light that was more dazzling than the sun appeared in the alley.
The tall old man came at him with overwhelming force, and punched the blade directly. The back of his hand was cut with a bloody mark by the sharp blade. After the old eunuch's feet landed with a bang, he continued to rush forward, pushing the girl holding the knife back. The old man then lightly stretched out his palm and looked. It seemed to be slow and calm, but in reality he pushed the girl's forehead like lightning. Just as the old man was about to apply more force, he smashed the head hidden under the curtain with his palm. He quickly moved his steps, moved one foot sideways, made a thud, looked down, and saw a sharp weapon penetrating his right chest from the back, which was the tip of the sword.
The old man's expression remained unchanged, he clamped the tip of the sword with his fingers together and pushed it back.
He pushed the sharp flying sword that followed the girl's will out of his chest.
Because of the obstruction of the flying sword, the old eunuch was not able to smash the girl's head with one palm. The girl's body flew backwards and fell into the alley. Taking this opportunity to breathe, she stood up and was as strong as a civet cat, and quickly disappeared from an alley.
The young man's face was horribly gloomy, his fists were clenched, and he was full of energy. He said with an angry look on his face: "The eunuch of the imperial horse supervisor, Wu Yue and Wu Diao Temple! Why don't you listen to my hints and insist on acting so paranoid? Do you really think that you, Wu Diao Temple, are the most invincible in this town? It was obviously our mistake first, and she was not aggressive afterward and was willing to settle the matter. Why are you still so vicious? It's simply too much! "
The old eunuch looked away from the direction of the girl's escape in the alley, turned around and walked back, his waist straight and looking even more majestic. The old man walked back slowly step by step, as if stepping heavily on his heart.
The young man felt the suffocating power, being oppressed by a slave, and was filled with rage. His eyes widened, and he gritted his teeth and said: "Prince Chariot Wu Diao Si, you are committing a capital crime! "
The old eunuch said calmly: "Your Majesty, your Majesty must decide whether you are guilty of death or alive. From our family's point of view, His Highness's safety is of paramount importance and is placed in the most important position. And the existence of the small town girl has become a top priority for our family. Therefore, if we really want everything to go well, we can only feel at ease if she is killed. If she dies, our family will be at ease. "
Seeing the almost uncontrollable raging anger in the young man's eyes, the old eunuch sighed and said softly: "Having served in the palace for more than sixty years, our family has seen too many intrigues, bloody and bloodless, countless. We really have no confidence in people's hearts. Just for the assassinations on the way to escort, our family has personally solved no less than thirty cases, large and small. Your Highness, the insidiousness and cunningness of those assassins are absolutely beyond imagination, especially some of the crazy dead warriors, which are simply unreasonable. Take the masked killer and the girl in the hood just now..."
The young man in brocade stretched out his finger, pointed at the cold-faced old eunuch, and angrily accused: "Shut up! You old eunuch! I don't want to hear your nonsense! I am only sure that you ruined my careful efforts. Even though you are blind, you also know how talented and stunning the girl who can control the flying sword is! Even among the practitioners on the mountain, she is still the most outstanding genius! Such a character, let alone Da Sui or Da Li, even in the entire Dongbaopingzhou, she is also a rare existence! I only need to train her for ten years, or at most twenty years, and she will become the most powerful assassin in the shadow behind me! No matter you are a land god or a martial arts master, what does it matter? ! The result? I am Gao Zhen, the future prince of the Sui Dynasty! You are the master of Old Eunuch Wu! "
Strangely enough, instead of being annoyed by the "old eunuch", the old eunuch who had experienced many vicissitudes of life, instead looked more and more pleased. After the young man finished venting his anger, he finally stopped cursing. The old man looked at the panting young man and smiled and said: "Your Highness, although you may not have experienced some things personally, so you don't know the treacherous world and the sinister people, but there is something your Highness has done very well, which is very much like His Majesty's demeanor back then. "
The atmosphere was awkward.
After Gao Zhen calmed down, he probably realized that he was very wrong. Before he was appointed as the crown prince, he was so disrespectful to an old man who was a eunuch and one of the three gatekeepers of the Sui Dynasty. Moreover, this person also won the trust of his father, the emperor and his mother. So the prince Gao Zhen opened his mouth, but when he saw the powerful eunuch whom he called an old eunuch, he smiled and said: "Your Highness, this servant may not appreciate it. Even if you feel guilty, you should bury it deeply in your heart. You must know that the emperor and king, who are known as the true dragons in the world, are the Nine-Five Lords who speak of the Constitution of Heaven..."
Gao Zhen said: "Grandpa Wu, with my current status, it is too early to say this. "
The old eunuch suddenly tensed up, as if facing a formidable enemy, and pulled the young man in brocade clothes behind him. The old eunuch looked towards the body of the masked killer.
A slender middle-aged Confucian scholar suddenly appeared at the end of the alley, walked in slowly, and came to the killer's body. After squatting down, he took off his scarf and saw only a strange face with no eyebrows, a shaved nose, and words carved on his face.
There is no doubt that this man was once a prisoner in his life.
The Confucian scholar was silent. He had indeed planned it for a long time. I am afraid that this plan will start from the Confucian Temple.
Gao Zhen's eyes were blazing. He walked out from behind the old eunuch, bent down and bowed. No matter what, he saluted first before speaking, and then he raised his head and asked respectfully: "May I ask if you are Mr. Qi from Shanya Academy? "
The Confucian scholar stood up and said to Gao Zhen: "If you hadn't taken the lead in seizing a great opportunity, the two of you would not have been able to leave so easily today. "
Outsiders fight each other in the town. According to the rules established by the first four saints, the punishment is not heavy, but it cannot be considered light. Compared with the indiscriminate killing of ordinary people in the town, who will inevitably be expelled, there is an obvious "loophole" in the fight between outsiders, allowing people to make up for it. The reason why the three groups of people, including Gao Zhen, all carry a "follower", It is precisely because of this that we have made the worst preparations to be introduced as a scapegoat at a critical moment. Otherwise, just one quota will cost half of the internal savings of Emperor Gao of the Sui Dynasty. At least it is the private money of a powerful emperor and the emperor, and half of the family's wealth. The amount is huge, one can imagine, so who is willing to be taken advantage of for no reason?
In fact, to put it simply, it is just spending money to eliminate disasters.
It's just that the expenses here can be described as emptying out a mountain of gold and silver. The so-called lavish spending in the secular market is simply child's play in comparison.
Gao Zhen, who was ordered to be expelled as a guest, continued to mind his own business and said: "Mr. Qi, if you have the opportunity in the future, can you come to our Sui Academy to give lectures? I, the Great Sui Dynasty, am willing to spare the position of ‘National Preceptor’ just for my husband! "
The old eunuch thought for a while, but still did not stop the young man's arrogant remarks.
If he could really convince this scholar to make suggestions for the Gao family in the Sui Dynasty in the future, the Emperor of the Sui Dynasty would definitely be delighted with Long Yan.
The Confucian scholar smiled and did not reply.
The old eunuch was decisive and ruthless in his treatment of the girl in the curtain hat who met by chance. At this time, facing this Dinghai Shenzhen who was sitting here, Shanya AcademyMr. Qi showed another extreme attitude, lowered his head and clasped his fists and said: "Mr. Qi, I'm sorry for bothering you so much, but I hope Haihan will do it. I just had no choice but to take action against a junior. I hope that Mr. Qi will understand our painstaking efforts as a slave of the Gao family."
Qi Jingchun waved her sleeves and said, "Leave quickly."
Gao Zhen and the old eunuch had no choice but to say goodbye and leave, taking the retreating route of the girl in the curtain hat.
The young man asked in a low voice: "She is dead?"
The old eunuch shook his head and said: "I'm sure she will die soon. The flying sword is just to let her live a little longer, and it will not help."
The young man hesitated for a moment and asked curiously: "When did Grandpa Wu realize that her control of the flying sword was actually far less relaxed and comfortable than it seemed on the surface?"
The old man said: "Too much is not enough, her precocious wisdom let it slip."
The young man was surprised and puzzled.
The old eunuch led the young man out of the original alley and said softly: "We have a question for Your Highness. After seeing so many rich and luxurious rare objects in the world, will Your Highness still be interested in ordinary porcelain from a small town?"
The young man patted his waist pocket and said with a smile: "Of course not. Only this Fang Yuxi, or something similar to it, can make me happy."
The old eunuch nodded and said: "That's exactly what it is. When that girl was killing people with her sword, her mind was as calm as water, and she was extremely calm and calm, just like... an ordinary person eating, drinking, and having sex. And after realizing my true martial arts skills afterwards, she decisively gave up the idea of fighting, especially because she was afraid that I would see through her ruthless appearance and deliberately provoke us. Her true intention was to benefit both parties. We each find a way to go down, because we are afraid that we would rather kill her than release her, so she must break the situation. Of course, it turns out that she is not doing well. But in the end, it is not easy to have such thoughts at such a young age. But the more so, the greater the threat to His Highness in the future once the tiger is released and allowed to thrive. "
The old man sighed: "When young girls are in high spirits, it would not be strange for our family if they kill with passion or go to death generously, but it would be abnormal for them to die calmly after careful consideration, or to kill people who cannot afford to cause any ripples in their hearts. It can even be seen. It can be said that this temperament can only be tempered by experience, and has little to do with a person's talent or qualifications. Whether it is a monk or a warrior, many geniuses die early because their temperament is too obvious and they are prone to bad things when encountering difficulties. "
Gao Zhen lamented: "No matter what, it's a pity."
The old eunuch joked half-truthfully: "Your Highness, if the life and death of such a character requires a sigh, then Your Highness will be very busy when he actually stands on the top of the mountain."
The young man laughed and said, "I don't believe it."
The old eunuch suddenly said: "I don't know if it's an illusion, but our family feels that Mr. Qi, who has a great level of cultivation, seems to have a big problem."
The Prince of the Sui Dynasty said with a nonchalant expression: "Anyway, as long as we can get this 'Dragon Gate' seal, we will be successful. Who would have thought that this priceless seal has turned into a small addition to a big deal, so it's time for us to accept it as soon as we see fit. When I talk about that golden carp, I can't help but think of that straw-shoe boy..."
The old eunuch smiled and said: "Your Highness is thinking of finding an opportunity in the future to thank this young man?"
The young man shook his head and said, "Where is it? I feel sorry for that bag of copper coins."
The old man laughed dumbly.
Maybe there will be a diligent and thrifty emperor in the Sui Dynasty in the future?

A secluded alley running north-south, with only the sound of rumbling cars.
There is a young Taoist priest with a lotus crown on his head. He has stopped doing business early today and is pushing a cart. He wants to clean up and go home after returning to his residence. Whoever is meddling in this mess will ruin it.
A slender man in black suddenly staggered out from the intersection of the east-west alley, and finallyHe leaned his back against the wall and moved slowly, with one hand passing over the veil to reveal the gauze, covering his mouth hard, and pointing one finger at the young Taoist.
The young Taoist quickly lowered his head and muttered silently: "You can't see me... You can't see me... Taishang Laojun is as anxious as the law... Forget it, it's the Buddha's blessing and the Bodhisattva's appearance..."
It is really outrageous for a Taoist priest to go to the Buddha and Bodhisattva instead of praying to the Patriarch of the Sanqing Dynasty when a crisis comes.
Sure enough, the Buddha and Bodhisattva seemed unwilling to pay attention to the disciples and disciples of other sects. The girl in the curtain hat came out of nowhere and staggered towards the Taoist with her last bit of strength. She fell heavily with a plop, but in the end she firmly held the Taoist's ankle with one hand.
The young Taoist held his head in both hands, with a miserable look on his face, as if he was looking up to the sky: "Such a big cause and effect is coming, doesn't it mean that I have to carve the four words 'Want to die' on my forehead? I have traveled all over the world in these years, eating and sleeping in the open air, traveling through mountains and rivers, and have experienced You often get bitten by dogs when you walk on the street... It's very hard, okay! Fuck your mother, the Sui Gao family, and the old dog named Wu, you just wait for Pindao. This debt does not last for five hundred years, and it is impossible to calculate it... Pindao's Taoist cultivation is so shallow, he really can't bear any heavy burden..."
The young Taoist who was already incoherent lowered his head, but he was just shy of tears. "Little girl, please show mercy and let me go. When I come back, I will help you find a place with beautiful mountains and clear waters. The feng shui is very good, and it will definitely bring blessings to your heirs... Oh no, the girl is still a yellow flower girl, then..."
The girl had completely fainted.
Seeing no one around, the young Taoist knelt down and quietly opened the girl's fingers.
Whoosh.
The flying sword hovered in the air, and the tip of the sword was only three inches away from the young Taoist's eyebrows.
The young Taoist silently let go of his hand, with a face full of pity, and said with awe and dignity: "Human beings are not grass and trees, how can we not have compassion? This poor Taoist has been so prosperous in his life, how can he be the kind of person who refuses to save anyone?!"
The young Taoist sat cross-legged, his handsome face almost wrinkled, "Where to send him next, it will be troublesome."
The flying sword that had been three inches away from the Taoist's eyebrows quickly moved forward an inch.
The Taoist patiently explained: "If you want your master to survive, Pindao needs a helper. By the way, you go to the old locust tree and poke a locust leaf. Pindao will hold on to her vitality first. Your master is a bit special. Pindao doesn't want to save people indiscriminately for the sake of saving others. If the time comes, he will accidentally delay her cultivation career. This new cause and effect...it makes Pindao want to die for a hundred times..."
Feijian seemed to be hesitating, the tip of the sword trembling slightly.
The Taoist said angrily: "If you go a little earlier, your master will be able to come back from the gate of hell a little earlier. If you go too late, everyone will die together!"
Feijian disappeared in the blink of an eye.
The Taoist said angrily in a low voice: "Only when a man is in love and has a concubine, he becomes a husband and a beautiful wife. You, Mr. Qi Jingchun and Qi Da, are better off. You mess around with the mandarin duck rules and don't even wipe your butt when you poop!"
The young Taoist held his chin in one hand and pinched his fingers with the other to tell fortunes, "Tao Rong is here to figure out which family to send you to in the town. You can survive and the other family will not be ruined. Let's start with the Lu family... The Lu family can't do it. It's similar to the Zhao family. We already have the opportunity. Then the Song family?"
The Taoist in the alley here has not yet finished speaking.
In the Song family's courtyard on Fulu Street, all the door gods posted on the large and small doors instantly lost their spirit and became dim. There were also wisps of green smoke invisible to the naked eye.
Deep in the courtyard, a barefooted old man pushed out the door, stood in the courtyard and yelled angrily: "Which bastard is plotting against my Song family's foundation?! Stand up and fight!"
The young Taoist coughed and said to himself: "The Liu family on Fulu Street, looking at the prosperity, looks like a master who can handle things. Let's give it a try?"
The plaque of the Liu family's family hall, which has been passed down for thousands of years, suddenlyIt shattered, and shocking cracks appeared.
There was an old woman with a deep voice, and she hit the ground heavily with her dragon-headed walking stick, "Who is this sacred person? Can you come out and see me?!"
The young Taoist pretended that nothing happened, "What about the Wei family on Taoye Lane? It seems that your family has accumulated good deeds and must be able to withstand this cause and effect."
Soon an old man used a secret method to transmit sound and roared to the school: "Qi Jingchun! You don't care?! If you can't or don't dare to care, get out and give up your position to Ruan Qiong! Let him deal with this sneaky guy! Or is this all just you, Qi Jingchun, venting your personal grudges?"
There was a man on the bank of the creek south of the covered bridge in the town, leading people to dig a well. He stood upright and moved his lips slightly to the north.
Like spring thunder, it rolled over Fulu Street and Taoye Lane, "Enough! You are not allowed to disrespect Mr. Qi, and I, Mr. Ruan, will never get involved in town affairs before the Spring Equinox!"
For a time, the heaven and earth were lonely, and everything was silent.
The culprit sitting next to the cart in the alley was grabbing the hand of the girl in black, and then dropped the green locust leaf brought by the flying sword onto her blood-stained palm.
After the locust leaf touched the wound on the girl's palm, it disappeared instantly like ice and snow melting.
The young Taoist sighed with emotion: "Every time I see this scene, I feel that this is the contribution of heaven and earth to creation..."
After brewing for a long time, the Taoist could not come up with words that he was satisfied with.
The young Taoist finally lowered his head and looked at the girl who was slightly radiant. He felt a little embarrassed and said, "Since the energy involved in you is greater than I imagined, I have no choice but to go against the grain. In the small town, there are six hundred families, intertwined with each other, and have been immersed in it for generations. With the aura of this secret realm, it would be easy for Pindao to find someone with aura, but it would be harder to find a pauper than to go to heaven.
